name: Adroit Marauder
subtitle: dexterous dangling debaucher
rules: While your opponent has at least 10 cards in their discard pile, this card gains 3 strength and 3 life.
flavor: A grandfather clock, a bucket of jewels, a priceless heirloom and his daughter's virginity...he'll think twice next time he leaves the window unbolted.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog says 'an opponent'. No artist credit in footer. 1st Edition badge.

name: Ambuscade
subtitle: i've been saving this all day!
rules: COST – Play this only when you are being attacked. Destroy a character you control. X is twice that character's strength. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage divided however you want to the attacking party.
notes: Catalog templating: EXTRA COST / Deploy this only while / 'its strength' for 'that character's strength'. No artist credit.

name: Befuddling Beggar
subtitle: stench so thick you can chew it
rules: PANHANDLE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character either gains or loses 1 speed.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Bipolar Sarcophyle
subtitle: cast into the gloomy depths of eternal cheer
rules: When this card enters play, flip a coin. If you win, put a token on this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Card Counter
subtitle: luck's got nothing to do with it
rules: When this card enters play, flip a coin. If you win, X is 3 otherwise X is 2. Put the top X cards of your opponent's deck into their discard pile.
flavor: It must be all the Jinn of Elk he drinks.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's deck'; catalog says 'an opponent's deck'. No artist credit.

name: Carnival King
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: CONGA LINE -- COST – Pay 3. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, all characters able to block the character must do so. When an attacking party is formed that includes the character, it must have only 1 member.
notes: Printed 'that includes the character'; catalog 'including the character' (same). Artist Series card; the artist (Silvia Gunarso) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer. Faded logo watermark behind text.

name: Catastrophic Betrayal
subtitle: we thought you were dead...and on our side!
rules: COST – Play this only when you are attacking. Pick a character in your opponent's discard pile. (You cannot attack with 0 characters.) -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control. Add the character to the attacking party, depleted.
notes: Catalog templating: EXTRA COST / Deploy this only while / 'an opponent's' for 'your opponent's' / 'as a member of the attacking party. Deplete it.' for 'Add the character to the attacking party, depleted.'; catalog omits the italic reminder '(You cannot attack with 0 characters.)'. No artist credit.

name: Costly Filcher
subtitle: if you've got the money, he'll get the prize
flavor: As long as it's not too hard. Or very far away. Or on Saturday. Or before noon.
notes: No rules text. No artist credit.

name: Deception
notes: Card is printed rotated 90 degrees. Faction ROGUE at left, STAPLE RESOURCE bar, name DECEPTION. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot (with a 1st Edition Part 2 badge); no collector number, no artist credit. No rules text.

name: Defenestrate
subtitle: look it up
rules: Put the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck into their discard pile. Draw a card.
flavor: "I'm making great time! Usually I'm just sniffing my model's underwear by now."
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's deck'; catalog says 'an opponent's deck'. No artist credit.

name: Dock Sentinel
subtitle: talk to the hand
flavor: I almost hope he doesn't go away. It's been a few hours since I've kicked someone's ass.
notes: No rules text. No artist credit.

name: Emergency Obfuscation
subtitle: your head a splode
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- While this card is in play, both players switch seats. Both players are in control of their opponent's side. If the game ends, the owner of the winning deck wins the game. -- At the start of your turn, you must put a token on this card. -- At the end of your turn, if there are at least 2 tokens on this card, destroy it.
notes: Card says both players switch seats; catalog says each player moves 1 seat to the left (differs from 'switch seats' with more than 2 players). Catalog uses TACTICAL keyword for 'may play whenever you could play a tactic'. Otherwise equivalent. No artist credit.

name: Entrancing Harlot
subtitle: i'd hit that
rules: If this card attacks, all other members of its party gain 1 speed this turn.
flavor: She keeps taking them up there, but I've yet to see anyone come down.
notes: Printed 'If this card attacks'; catalog 'When this card attacks' (same trigger). No artist credit.

name: Face in the Crowd
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: While your opponent controls at least 4 characters and this card is the only member of an attacking party, this card cannot be blocked.
flavor: All our WACOMs were taken, so Silvia did this oldschool: with a pencil.
notes: Card also requires 'this card is the only member of an attacking party'; catalog omits that condition (card is unblockable more often in the catalog). Catalog says 'an opponent' for 'your opponent'. Artist Series card; the artist (Silvia Gunarso) is credited in the subtitle, not the footer. Faded 'Artist Series' watermark over the flavor text.

name: Ferrous Ferret
subtitle: man's best (and worst) friend
rules: While this card is in play, anything that could pick it must pick it. -- If this card is picked, put a token on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
flavor: They say ferrets are the highest tier of weapon. What is beyond the ferret tier? A vast, great white nothingness.
notes: Catalog templating: 'can pick' vs 'could pick', 'When this card is picked' vs 'If', and the in-play condition moved to a parenthetical. No artist credit.

name: Forced Recruitment
subtitle: busty sarcophyles...my only weakness!
rules: COST – Play this only in response to a character being played. X is that character's numeric cost. Pay X. -- EFFECT – The character enters play under your control.
flavor: Bored with her pallid harem, the sarcophyle mistress is always hungry for handsome new playthings.
notes: Catalog templating: EXTRA COST / Deploy / deployed, and 'Pay X, where X is its numeric cost' for 'X is that character's numeric cost. Pay X.'. No artist credit.

name: Grand Theft All
subtitle: should have locked the door
rules: Put up to 4 characters, items, locations, and/or resources from your opponent's discard pile into play under your control.
notes: Catalog says 'non-tactic cards in an opponent's discard pile'; card lists characters, items, locations and/or resources (same set) and says 'your opponent's'. No artist credit.

name: Hangdog Alley
subtitle: refuge of outcasts
rules: When an attacking party is formed, it must have only 1 member.
flavor: Its confusing design and plentiful exits make Hangdog Alley the perfect retreat for those wishing to avoid the law. Justice is handled by the locals and traitors are dealt with swiftly.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Headlong Purloiner
subtitle: you brought the woman too? bonus!
flavor: The great thing about Randy is that he really throws himself into whatever he does.
notes: No rules text. No artist credit.

name: Heist Planner
subtitle: so cunning you could brush your teeth with it
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your opponent's deck for up to 3 cards with different names and put them into your opponent's discard pile.
flavor: "You throw the paintings out of the window and we'll run by and pick them up."
notes: Catalog adds 'and reveal them. If you do, put them into that player's discard pile'; card has no reveal step and puts the cards into the discard pile unconditionally (catalog reveals information and adds an 'If you do' condition). No artist credit.

name: Hyperphagic Sarcophyle
subtitle: bottomless glutton of blood
rules: If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you may put a token on this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
flavor:
"The suave sarcophyle we know in society is a myth; if our young people really understood what these monsters become, if they could see the wake of tragedy and despair, they would never seek to convert."
— Ernest Arndell, 'A Cancer in our Midst: On Sarcophelia and the Coming Plague'
notes: Printed 'If this card inflicts damage'; catalog 'When' (same trigger). Attribution surname reads 'Arndell' (rn/m ambiguous at this resolution; Ernest/Emest same glyphs). No artist credit.

name: Impulsive Abductress
subtitle: take me! take me!
rules: KIDNAP -- COST – Destroy this card. Pick an attacking or blocking character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character.
flavor:
A hearty lass, she sailed the seas
A queen of all things nautical
She snatched up men with wanton ease
Whene'er she felt erotical
notes:
Flavor is a four-line centered verse; lines separated with 
. No artist credit.

name: Incriminating Photograph
subtitle: the wig is very slimming
rules: When this card enters play, name a non-resource card. -- The named card cannot be played.
flavor: Another photo in Dr. Unpeg Noon's distinct style.
notes: Catalog says 'cannot be deployed' for 'cannot be played'. No artist credit.

name: Jackmove
subtitle: he gets what he wants, even if it's yours
rules: COST – Pick a number for X. Pay twice X. -- EFFECT – Reveal the top X cards of your opponent's deck. Put all revealed characters and items into play under your control, and the remaining cards into your opponent's discard pile.
flavor: "What do you mean you're Baron Unfigeld? The Baron arrived almost two hours ago! Oswaldo, throw this lunatic out onto the street at once."
notes: Card reveals exactly 'the top X cards'; catalog says 'up to the top X cards' (lets the player reveal fewer than X; probably deck-size templating but changes the rule as written). 'Pay X+X' = 'Pay twice X'. Catalog says 'an opponent's' for 'your opponent's'. No artist credit.

name: Jumping Screamspider
subtitle: it smells your fear
rules: COVERT -- SCREAM -- COST – Pay 0. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card loses COVERT and while it's in a battle, all characters in the opposing party lose 2 speed.
notes: Card: SCREAM cost is 'Pay 0' and losing COVERT is part of the EFFECT. Catalog: the COST is 'This card loses COVERT this turn' (loss of COVERT becomes a paid cost) and the effect only has the speed loss. No artist credit.

name: Master Scavenger
subtitle: plundering where others fear to tread
rules: RECLAIM -- COST – Remove 3 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. -- EFFECT – This card gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: After the inhabitants pick the bones clean, they just throw the treasure away.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog says 'an opponent's'. No artist credit.

name: Pillaging Pirate
subtitle: so long, fatty!
rules: When this card enters play, put the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck into their discard pile.
flavor: Ogdred the Unreliable had been waiting for the right moment to start his own pirating franchise. An absent-minded order to carry the loot proved his perfect opportunity.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's deck'; catalog says 'an opponent's deck'. No artist credit.

name: Pluck
subtitle: crafty exploiter of scenes
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- GRIFT -- COST – Use this only during your turn. Pay 5. Deplete this card. Pick a non-tactic card in your opponent's discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the card into play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog says 'an opponent's'. No artist credit.

name: Rapine
subtitle: you'll be coming with us now
rules: COST – Destroy a character or item you control. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Take control of the picked character.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: labeling. No artist credit.

name: Ravenous Wolf
subtitle: so...chicken again?
rules: COVERT -- You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. If you do, destroy a card named "Deception" you control or destroy this card.
notes: Card: the drawback applies whenever you use the 'play whenever you could play a tactic' permission ('If you do'). Catalog: TACTICAL keyword plus an enters-play trigger 'if you deployed it during an opponent's turn' (a different condition: e.g. tactic-timing play during your own turn would not trigger it). No artist credit.

name: Recondite Hunter
subtitle: he'll never see it coming
rules: COVERT -- If this card attacks, it loses COVERT this turn.
flavor: "But if you're the police, who will police the police?"
notes: Printed 'If this card attacks'; catalog 'When this card attacks' (same trigger). No artist credit.

name: Red Raven
subtitle: always calls "tails"
rules: If a coin is flipped, you may put a token on this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Printed 'If a coin is flipped'; catalog 'When a coin is flipped' (same trigger). No artist credit.

name: Rocket Boots
subtitle: "hey...that's not the wallet inspector!"
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 1 strength and 1 speed. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 3. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: Badges read +1 STR, +0 LIFE, +1 SPD. Subtitle is printed in quotation marks. No artist credit.

name: Sarcophyle Matriculation
subtitle: some choices can never be undone
rules: COST – Play this only when you are being attacked. Pick a character your opponent controls. -- EFFECT – If the character would be destroyed during this battle, instead put it into play under your control, depleted. It becomes a "sarcophyle".
flavor: Those seeking cultured notoriety and a bohemian lifestyle beg Sarcophyle lords to share their essence.
notes: Card puts the character into play under your control, depleted, and it 'becomes a sarcophyle'. Catalog: take control, reduce its damage to 0, it 'gains the sarcophyle subtype' and no 'depleted'. Catalog also says 'an opponent controls' vs printed 'your opponent controls'. No artist credit.

name: Scrag
subtitle: quick and painful
rules: COST – Pick a character. X is that character's life. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character if your opponent has at least X cards in their discard pile.
flavor: N.E.D.M.
notes: Card checks YOUR OPPONENT's discard pile; catalog checks the picked character's controller's discard pile (differs when the picked character is yours). No artist credit.

name: Snake Eyes
subtitle: take him away!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If the character has received damage this turn, destroy it. Draw a card.
flavor: "Oh, too bad sir."
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: labeling. No artist credit.

name: Sudden Osprey
subtitle: who keeps a bird in a treasure chest?
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, that character gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: "Honestly. A bird in a treasure chest."
notes: Catalog uses TACTICAL keyword for 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic' and 'it' for 'that character'. No artist credit.

name: Swashbuckler
subtitle: dashing seeker of danger
rules: When this card enters play, you may remove 4 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. If you don't, destroy this card.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog says 'an opponent's'. No artist credit.

name: The Billionaire
subtitle: always on the guest list
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- You may use abilities on your opponent's cards as though you were your opponent. (The effect still happens to your opponent.) -- CHANGE COSTUME -- COST – Pay 3. Shuffle this card into its owner's deck. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a "pluck" card with a different name than this card and put it into play.
notes: Catalog adds that numeric costs are paid with your own resources and that additional costs are satisfied as though your opponent is using the ability (card only says 'as though you were your opponent'); catalog also says to reveal the searched card and put it into play 'under your control' (card has neither 'reveal' nor 'under your control'). No artist credit.

name: Thief Doyen
subtitle: it's good to be the king
rules: COST – Discard a character or item. X is that card's numeric cost. -- This card enters play with X tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: labeling. No artist credit.

name: Tremor Engine
subtitle: enormous tool of mass plunder
rules: At the start of your turn, both players must put the top 2 cards of their deck into their discard pile.
notes: Printed 'both players must put'; catalog 'each player puts'. No artist credit.

name: Vander Malagut
subtitle: seething hatred, seductive wit
rules: UNIQUE EVONDAN -- All your other "sarcophyle" characters gain 1 speed. -- If a character would be destroyed during a turn when this card damaged it, take control of that character instead. Treat that character as though it has received no damage this turn. It becomes a "sarcophyle". -- If this card is destroyed, destroy all other "sarcophyle" characters.
notes: Catalog templating: 'Reduce the amount of damage already inflicted to it this turn to 0' for 'Treat that character as though it has received no damage this turn'; 'It gains the sarcophyle subtype' for 'It becomes a "sarcophyle"'; 'When this card is destroyed' for 'If'. Judged same play. No artist credit.

name: Warehouse Raid
subtitle: it was almost worth it
rules: COST – Flip a coin. If you win X is 2, otherwise X is 1. -- EFFECT – Your opponent must discard X cards at random. Put any items discarded this way into play under your control.
notes: Printed 'Your opponent must discard'; catalog 'An opponent discards'. No artist credit.

name: Yoink!
subtitle: haugh haugh!
rules: COST – Pick a "gear" card and a character. -- EFFECT – Take control of the "gear" card and attach it to the character.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: labeling. No artist credit.

name: The Tournament Faction
rules: STARTING RESOURCES – Any 2 staple resources. -- STARTING DRAW – 8 going first, 9 going second. -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, pick one of the following: draw a card or play a resource. -- DRAW -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- RESOURCE -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource.
notes: Faction card with artwork (tournament arena), no artist credit, no type line, no collector number; 'STAPLE' in the rarity slot with a 1st Edition badge. Title bar reads THE TOURNAMENT FACTION, INFLUENCE – 25. Image is a scan of a physical card (slightly different shape).

name: Arena Quarter-Finalist
subtitle: it's hard damn work being this good
flavor: Any rookie can swing a sword; mastery is about keeping your footing when the ring is thick with gore.
notes: No rules text. No artist credit. Blue Warlord card frame.
